newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat not interested in San Paolo stake.
newsitem.headline: Fiat not interested in San Paolo stake.

text.p: Italian car maker Fiat said it was not interested in taking a stake in Turin-based banking group Istituto San Paolo di Torino, which is due to be privatised from its public foundation this year.
In a statement, Fiat said: "Fiat rules out any interest in entering the capital of the Turin bank."
San Paolo said on Monday it was offering a total of 45 percent of its capital currently owned by San Paolo Holding in a public share offer and a private placement with istitutional investors.
San Paolo chairman Gianni Zandano said on Monday he hoped to woo Turin-based Fiat into taking part in the sell-off, as well as investors from France, Germany and possibly Britain.
"I personally hope that the most important productive force in Turin is present in the shareholding structure," he said.
